periods.summary: Kurono accompanies Itsuki to the secret Ohu-Wagadake Special Prison after followers of Tendo's cult try to raid it. She captures the raiders with Clock Draw, listens as Itsuki explains the Heaven-Guided Sect and the Occupation of the Imperial Hotel, and is ordered to prepare her forbidden World Crisis technique if Harima moves. When Cocytus is opened, the cell is empty, confirming that Great Flame has escaped.

key_events.summary: Helps stop the cultists and witnesses the empty Cocytus cell.
